problems: Cliopatria's 'Janapada of Gandhāra' and 'Janapada of Kamboja' shapes appear swapped: Gandhāra's (74.4E 33.4N) sits at Rajouri, where the Mahajanapadas page puts Kamboja's capital Rajapura, and Kamboja's (73.3E 33.5N) sits on the Rawalpindi plateau beside Taxila. Both Gandhāra shapes are marked wrong and replaced by the Peshawar valley + Taxila + Kashmir valley; the Kamboja dossier (sa-01, another part) should be checked against janapada-of-gandhara's notes.

Indus Valley Civilization was not split: the pages describe one culture in three phases, not successive states. Written as type 'culture' (as the group scope asks) with the life extended from -3000..-1701 to the infobox's -3300..-1300 and three new keyframes (_-3300, _-1900, _-1700); the rendering agents should expect a muted, dotted culture that outlives the schema's 'before 3400 BCE' wording for cultures.

Matching events for other dossiers: janapada-of-magadha should gain Anga in -530 (its Haryanka row starts only in -500); magadha-shaishunaga-dynasty should gain Avanti (with Vatsa) in -405 and Aśmaka in -345; achaemenid-empire (another group) should gain the Peshawar valley in -535 and the Taxila country in -518; janapada-of-vatsa should carry a loss to Avanti in -450 (confidence 1) or correct that date.

Three janapada ends were moved from Cliopatria's years to the pages': Anga -501 to -530, Gandhāra -501 to -518, Aśmaka -351 to -345; the superseded Cliopatria shapes carry wrong/adjust verdicts saying whose the land is.

All ten janapada shapes are ~5,000 km2 city cores; the pages give regions ten to thirty times larger (Malwa for Avanti, Peshawar valley + Taxila + Kashmir for Gandhāra), and Aśmaka and Cedi are each ~110-130 km from where the pages place them. Every janapada keyframe is adjust or wrong with a named-region correction.
The Mulaka page would not load under 'Mulaka' or 'Mūlaka' (URL_NOT_FOUND twice each); the annexation is recorded from the Asmaka page at confidence 1.
